segments.name: banking
products: commercial, real estate and consumer loans
segments.description: Community banking services offering commercial, real estate and consumer loans, time deposits, checking and savings accounts to individuals and businesses.
segments.evidence: all of the community banking services and branch locations are considered by management to be aggregated into one reportable operating segment, banking.

revenueModel.text: Borrowers pay interest on loans, and the bank also earns revenue from investments and deposits.
revenueModel.evidence: Loans, investments, and deposits provide the significant revenues and interest expense, provision for credit losses and salaries and employee benefits comprise the significant expenses within the banking segment.
